agent_evaluations.detailed_rationale: This OSCE fails to meet minimum safety standards for self-harm assessment. The content is entirely templated placeholder text without specific clinical details. Critical SAFE-T protocol elements are absent. A medical student completing this OSCE would not learn how to conduct a proper suicide/self-harm risk assessment, which is a dangerous educational gap. The scenario must be completely rewritten with: (1) Specific patient presentation (e.g., '24F presents to ED 2 hours post-overdose of 20 paracetamol tablets after argument with partner'), (2) Complete SAFE-T assessment in expected answers, (3) Risk stratification with clear documentation, (4) Safety plan with specific elements, (5) Means restriction and follow-up timeline. RAG citations lack content verification. This represents a systematic problem across the entire 40-OSCE dataset - all appear to use the same generic template rather than specialty-specific content. Recommend rejecting entire batch and regenerating with clinical expert input.
